explication: YimMenuV2 is an injected experimental menu for GTA 5: Enhanced. The main workflow is injection and startup, menu interaction through registered commands, and execution of game-facing features; it also supports Lua scripts, saved settings, and several UI themes. The startup, command, Lua, UI-manager, player-hook, and sample feature links below are supported by the excerpts or README. Broader feature and backend relationships are shown only where documented or explicitly left unverified.
